about.fullProfile:
I am a Fullstack Developer with a diverse skill set, actively seeking a work opportunity.

I am deeply passionate about culture, art, and innovation.

As a self-taught software developer, I have gained practical experience by building and maintaining real-world applications, such as a portfolio website and various client projects. Over the past months, I have strengthened my skills in fullstack development, focusing on Vue.js, Node.js, and modern web technologies.

I continuously expand my knowledge through hands-on coding, online courses, and personal challenges. My goal is to keep growing as a developer and contribute to impactful, innovative projects.

fullstack.title: Fullstack Developer
fullstack.summary: Comprehensive web development: frontend, backend, APIs, and deployment. Specialized in building robust, scalable, and user-friendly applications.
details: Frontend: Vue.js, React, responsive design, accessibility, and performance optimization.
Backend: Node.js, Express, RESTful APIs, authentication, and database integration (SQL/NoSQL).
DevOps: Deployment, CI/CD, cloud services (Vercel, Netlify), and version control (Git).
Testing: Unit, integration, and end-to-end testing for reliable applications.
User experience: UI/UX best practices, usability improvements, and accessibility compliance.

business.title: Business Admin & Management
business.summary: Business management with a focus on organizational strategy, finance, marketing, sales, people management, project management, data analytics, sustainability, innovation, entrepreneurship, and digital skills. Specialized in developing sustainable businesses.
details: Recruitment and performance evaluation in real companies, using digital platforms and complying with local regulations.
Preparation and analysis of financial and accounting reports for decision-making in SMEs and organizations.
Development and execution of digital marketing and sales campaigns, applying market analysis tools and CRM systems.
Implementation of compensation and people development programs, adapted to organizational needs and current labor laws.
Financial statement evaluation to support business decisions, project management, and risk assessment in real contexts.
Design and management of marketing plans based on market research and digital tools.
Strategic management for continuous improvement and achievement of organizational objectives, using IT and adapting to changing environments.
Transversal skills: teamwork, effective communication, problem-solving, innovation, entrepreneurship, continuous learning, and ethical decision-making for sustainable business development.
